Officer's narrative
Officer narrative: On arrival in Houston, Texas, I found a rear-end collision involving two vehicles. Driver 2 was
stopped in the travel lane when the vehicle operated by Driver 1 struck the rear bumper. Driver 1 was seated behind
the wheel when I arrived, and I confirmed the presence of Driver 1 at the scene. A Passenger was also in the vehicle.
Damage to both vehicles is consistent with a low-speed impact of the kind described by the drivers. Driver 1 reported
neck and back strain and said the pain began shortly after the collision. The impact appeared minor, and the reported
injuries seem more serious than the damage would suggest. Photographs taken at the scene show the damage and
some details of the positions of the vehicles. No independent witnesses came forward. Both drivers gave statements
that match the photographs in most respects. A few old scratches were visible on the rear of Driver 1's vehicle, and it
is unclear whether they predate this collision. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy for that vehicle.
</page>
